sloka: महाजनसमीपे च मम चैव नरर्षभ ।ऋषिणा व्याहृतं वाक्यं वसिष्ठस्य च सन्निधौ ।। ७.५०.१४ ॥
transliteration: mahājanasamīpe ca mama caiva nararṣabha ।ṛṣiṇā vyāhṛtaṁ vākyaṁ vasiṣṭhasya ca sannidhau ।। 7.50.14 ॥

translations.english: O best among men, this statement was spoken by the sage (Valmiki) in a large gathering, in my presence, and also in the presence of Vasistha.
